mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high federal funds rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in payroll employment and a decline in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in strong labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production signals a weakening supply environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of weak industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in real personal consumption expenditures signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong personal consumption (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in the federal funds rate and a decline in the consumer price index signals a tightening monetary cycle with low inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle with low inflation
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in tightening periods with low inflation are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5% triggers a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in strong demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
